fields.PRODUCT NAME: Hand-Painted Marble Elephant Tea Coaster Set with Holder – Rajasthani Art
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a royal touch to your tea-time with this exquisite Rajasthani marble tea coaster set. Crafted from premium white marble, the holder and coasters are beautifully hand-painted with traditional motifs, featuring a majestic elephant adorned in vibrant colours and highlighted with golden accents.
